disclosures.change: Same-author risk: the same author wrote rules-v2.0 and this dataset in one session. rules-v2.0 was drafted first; its severe-harm lexicons were then switched to the structured restricted-evidence fields (policy_area=..., content_provided=...) when that format was designed for content-safety reasons, before any case was written. Detecting those fields is intended (it is how a restricted triage system would expose these cases), but it makes severe-area results easier than free-text reports would be.
